notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: The Election Commission is conducting a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls to modernize voter data through digitization.
notes.fact_box: The SIR is underway in 12 States and UTs, with over 68% of enumeration forms digitized so far. The enumeration phase started on November 4 and is set to conclude on December 4.

prelims_pointers.text: The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls is being conducted by the Election Commission of India (ECI).
Over 68% of the total existing electors' enumeration forms have been digitized in the second phase of SIR.
The SIR is being implemented in 12 States and Union Territories, including Chhattisgarh, Goa, and Uttar Pradesh.
The draft electoral roll list will be published on December 9, followed by the claims and objections period.

notes.mains_question: How does the digitization of electoral rolls enhance the transparency and inclusivity of the democratic process?
